snippet.title: Sugary Super Mario Bros. Wii - PreDEMO Trailer + DEMO Release Date!
snippet.description:
The Sweet Isles need your help! Bowser wants to control its candies and convert them into his minions!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cross through the different Candy Isles!
  - Lollipop Land
  - Chocolate Caverns
  - Gelato Beach
  - Candy Cane Winterland
  - Cotton Candy Nimbus
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Embark together with friends or on your own in Mario and friends' sweetest adventure in Sugary Super Mario Bros. Wii
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DEMO will include:
  - 15 levels (3 lvls in each world)
  - Same storyline as the FULL Game

RELEASING ON 11th April 2026!!

#sugarysmbw #hackrom #nsmbwii #nsmbw #trailer #demo #newsupermariobroswii #newersupermariobroswii
